kind_of_no: seasonal-lease RV community that sells lots; no nightly sale, no price, no presence of its own
why: No park named 'Lakeside RV Resort' exists at Lake Madison on Google Maps, RV Life (Algolia bbox 43.85..44.15 N, -97.25..-96.85, 2026-11-22), the Good Sam directory cache or the web; the only RV resort on the lake is Lakes RV Resort, 100 Silver Creek Dr/Trl, Wentworth (Google 'Lakes RV Resort' 4.6/30, RV park, (605) 483-3800, read 2026-11-22; rvpark.com lists it as 'Lakeshore Golf & RV Resort', same phone). Its own pages (golfatthelakes.com, Wayback 2019-05-15) call it a 'seasonal RV community' offering 'Seasonal RV Sites Available for Rent' and post only 'Seasonal Lease Rates ... (April 15th to Oct 15th) $2,500.00 or $2,700.00 depending on location of site'; the lease (BPS LLC dba Lakes RV Resort, Wayback 2017-01-08) is a 6-month term, and the site's RV Resort menu was 'Lots for Sale', with a 'South_Park_Sites_1-51_Map_with_Revisions_SOLD' site map; a 2025 MLS listing (#22500609, Century 21 / LandMark Realty, page now 404) offered unit 110 at 100 Silver Creek Trl, 0.08 acre, $63,000, in 'Lake Madison RV Resort'. The overnight rates it posted in 2012 ($30-49.50, 2-night weekend minimum) were gone by 2019. Today's golfatthelakes.com (read 2026-11-22) is the golf course only and never mentions the RV resort. Fails long-stay tests 2 (no nightly rate or booking), 3 (seasonal lease) and 5 (sells lots), and the private presence rule.
name: Lakes RV Resort (lead name 'Lakeside RV Resort')
flags: Lead 9 (lakeshore-golf-rv, 'Lakeshore Golf and RV Park') is almost certainly the SAME place: rvpark.com's 'Lakeshore Golf & RV Resort, 100 Silver Creek Trl, Wentworth' carries the same 605-483-3800 phone as Google's Lakes RV Resort, and the resort sits beside The Lakes Golf Course (19 Golf Dr, Wentworth) between Lake Madison and the lake to the east. Lead 9 can be skipped on this result unless its finder had a different place in mind.

Esri World Imagery crop (sat.py, rendered, 2026-11-22) at 43.937375,-96.986865 (900 m frame): roughly 150 RVs packed in curving rows on an isthmus between Lake Madison (west, across the county road and a row of lake houses) and the lake to the east, with decks and set-up units throughout - consistent with a seasonal-lease park. Waterfront was not audited because the park is skipped.

Google's 4.6/30 rating is shared with the bar and grill (one review praises its broasted chicken); the 2024 review says friends 'live there full time in the summer'. Google links golfatthelakes.com, which no longer mentions RV sites. Wayback shows spam 'health_blog' pages under golfatthelakes.com in late 2026, so the domain may be partly compromised. Never cite those pages.

Not a duplicate: the nearest DB entry is 5736 Walker's Point RA, about 3.6 km away; there is no Silver Creek or Lakes RV entry. Other private Lake Madison-area campgrounds on Google Maps 2026-11-22 with no DB entry, not vetted: Dirks Resort Campground (452A Ave, 4.2/27), Jacobs Landing Campground (6437 Evergreen Acres Dr, 4.7/16, Hipcamp listing), Cabana Shores Campground (46039 238th St, 5.0/6), Basler Private RV Park (3199 Basler Ct, 4.6/26).
